decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:3.3pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">The proposed development, due to the
intensification of the site and the number of people proposed to be on site
including existing and proposed occupiers, in conjunction with the insufficient
provision of reception facilities, and the failure to demonstrate accessibility
for all users, would result in an unreasonable degree of impacts with regard to
noise and disturbance to the detriment of the amenities of neighbouring
occupiers and existing occupiers of the site, and a development out of
character with the local surrounding context, which would fail to achieve the
highest standards of accessible and inclusive design. The proposal is therefore
considered to be contrary to Policies S3.B, D3.D(7), D5.B, D13 and D14 of The
London Plan (2021) and Policies DM1, DM2.b and DM46 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<b><o:p></o:p></b></span></p>
description: Change of use from self contained flats (use Class C3) to Nursery (use Class E) relating to ground floor.
